title: Lemon and Pistachio Baked Alaska
changes_from_base: A brown-butter pistachio and almond cake replaces the pound cake, a lemon semifreddo replaces the bought ice cream, and the meringue is a cooked Swiss meringue browned with a blowtorch.
summary: A nutty pistachio cake holds a silky lemon semifreddo, all finished with a blowtorched coat of marshmallowy meringue.
equipment: piping bag with large star nozzle

ingredients.item: egg whites (about 5 large), at room temperature
fine sea salt or table salt
egg whites (about 8 large), at room temperature

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Melt 150 g butter in a frying pan and cook, swirling, until nut-brown and fragrant, then pour into a bowl to cool.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Heat the oven to 180 °C and line a 20 cm tin; whisk 150 g egg whites to stiff, tripled peaks, then fold in 25 g ground almonds, 80 g ground pistachios, 160 g icing sugar, a pinch of salt and 50 g flour, followed by 10 g pistachio paste and the browned butter; bake for 20-25 min until set, then cool and turn out.

steps.title: Line
steps.text: Line a 1.2-1400 ml metal bowl with cling film.

steps.title: Boil
steps.text: Put 200 g caster sugar, 1 tbsp of the 133 ml lemon juice and 2 tbsp water in a saucepan, let it soak, then boil without stirring to 121 °C, about 10 min, while whisking 6 egg yolks separately until thick and pale, about 5 min.

steps.title: Whisk
steps.text: With the mixer on low, pour the hot syrup down the side of the bowl onto the yolks, then add the lemon zest, ½ tsp vanilla and the remaining lemon juice and beat on medium until completely cool.

steps.title: Fold
steps.text: Whip 355 ml double cream to stiff peaks and fold it through, then pour the mixture into the lined bowl, cover and freeze until firm, at least 6 h.

steps.title: Meringue
steps.text: Whisk 400 g caster sugar with 245 g egg whites in a heatproof bowl over simmering water until the sugar dissolves and the mixture reaches 71 °C, about 5 min, then whisk on high until glossy, stiff and cool, about 7 min.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.text: Cut a 15 cm round from the cake, turn the semifreddo out onto it, pipe the meringue all over from base to top, freeze until serving, then brown all over with a blowtorch.

tips: Boil the sugar syrup to exactly 121 °C on a sugar thermometer so the yolks cook safely without scrambling.
Freeze the semifreddo thoroughly, at least 6 h, before piping on the meringue so it holds its shape.
safety: Use pasteurised egg yolks if serving anyone pregnant, very young, elderly or unwell, as the yolks may not reach 71 °C throughout.
Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Keep the semifreddo frozen, well wrapped, for up to a week before topping with meringue and finishing to serve.
